meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: BOLERO-2: adding everolimus to hormone therapy roughly doubled progression-free survival in hormone-receptor-positive advanced breast cancer.
data.mechanism_beginner: Adding everolimus to hormone therapy roughly doubled the time before certain advanced breast cancers got worse.
data.boundary: Progression-free survival, in combination with exemestane - overall survival was not significantly improved.
data.note: Say PFS, not survival. The distinction is the whole argument of this Atlas.
